description: This file defines an Angular component called DocumentEditorComponent, which allows users to view and edit document details with real-time collaboration features via WebSocket connections. It manages user input, emits save events, and handles collaborative message synchronization.

classes.name: DocumentEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular standalone component for editing documents with real-time collaboration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component state, sets up WebSocket connection if editing is enabled.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and disconnects WebSocket on destruction.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Emits the save event with updated document details, sends edit over WebSocket if collaborative editing is enabled.

methods.name: onCollabMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming collaborative messages to update local editing state.

methods.name: onContentChange
methods.description: Handles changes in content, optionally sending updates over WebSocket.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the title, triggers content change logic.
